text: Program Introduction: Medical Laboratory Tests and Analyses is a specimen of the patient's blood, body fluid, secretions, or exfoliative cells to make a test to obtain the data of pathogenic, pathological changes and organ function, and its specialty is the specialized subject of methods, principles and results analysis. The major mainly study basic knowledge of basic medicine, clinical medicine and medical examination. They were trained by the medical test operation skills system and had the basic ability of clinical medical examination and health inspection. Requirments: 1. Master basic theoretical knowledge of basic medicine and clinical medicine; 2. Master the basic theories and techniques of medical chemistry, molecular biology, immunology, pathogenic diagnostics and blood cell morphology, and understand the basic components and properties of the commonly used inspection instruments; 3. Having the basic ability of mathematical statistics and computer application; 4. Be familiar with the principles, policies and regulations related to national health work and main management of clinical trials; 5. Understand the development trend of theory and technology of medical laboratory frontier science; 6. Mastering the basic methods of literature retrieval and data investigation, and have certain scientific research and practical working ability. Future career: Students can work in medical inspection and medical laboratories at all levels of hospitals, medical research institutions, blood stations, disease control centers, R & D and production of extracorporeal diagnostic reagents, commodity inspection, environmental protection, customs quarantine and other departments.
